WORKBOOK 5-UNITNING UChINChI BETI (24-bet). Yuqorida chapda to'q sariq '5' va 'Planning Ahead'.

CHAP USTUN:
11) 'Complete the sentences with the correct form of the verbs in brackets.' 1 If he ...... (miss) his flight, he won't be able to go to Madrid. 2 If you ...... (not/be) careful, you'll hurt yourself. 3 If she gets a job, she ...... (buy) a car. 4 If you drink some tea, you ...... (feel) better. 5 If he ...... (not/set) his alarm clock, he'll be late for work. 6 If she ...... (go) to the gym, she'll lose weight. 7 If I ...... (not/have) enough time to cook, I'll order a pizza. 8 If Sheila ...... (wake up) early, she'll do the shopping. 9 If it ...... (rain) tomorrow, we'll stay at home. 10 If you make dinner tonight, I ...... (do) the washing-up.
12) 'Match the items in column A to those in column B, as in the example.' A: 1 If I get a headache, 2 If you go to bed late tonight, 3 If I don't have lunch, 4 If you don't eat junk food, 5 If it gets warm in here, 6 If it stops raining, | B: a you will feel healthier. b I'll open the window. c I'll take an aspirin. d I'll be hungry later. e we'll go for a walk in the park. f you will be tired tomorrow. Strelka: 1 → c.
13) 'Use the prompts to make sentences, as in the example.' 'What will happen if you ...' 1 go to Paris? ...If I go to Paris, I will visit the Eiffel Tower.... 2 have a stomach ache tomorrow? 3 forget to tidy your room? 4 go to the city centre? 5 are very tired after dinner? 6 do well in your exams? 7 have a party? 8 miss the bus?

O'NG USTUN:
14) 'Look at the pictures below, then use the prompts to make sentences about what each person will do when they graduate this summer.' Markazda 'GRADUATE' (bitiruv qalpog'i) va 6 rasm: a Sidney (ko'prik va opera teatri) - Mark - go to Sydney; b Ozodlik haykali - Fay - travel to New York; c 'BRING A FRIEND' bazm taklifnomasi - Gary - have a party; d ochiq portfel - Kim - get a job; e kompyuter - Sam - buy a computer; f mashina - Ann - buy a car. a ...When Mark graduates, he'll go to Sydney.... b-f bo'sh.
• 'Communication: Making Appointments, Reminding and Reassuring People'.
15) 'Fill in the gaps with will, 'm afraid, 'd like, could or would.' A: Hello. I 1) ...... to speak to Mr Harris, please. B: I 2) ...... he's in a meeting at the moment. 3) ...... you like to leave a message? A: Yes, please. 4) ...... you tell him that Mr Jones called? B: Certainly, sir. I 5) ...... ask him to contact you as soon as he's finished. A: Thank you very much.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '24'.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the sentences with the correct form of the verbs in brackets.
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni qavsdagi fe'llarning to'g'ri shakli bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
ShART GAP - 1-TUR (Conditional
  Type 1).

  IF + PRESENT SIMPLE, ... WILL +
  fe'l.

  ⚠ 'IF' QISMIDA PRESENT (will
  EMAS!):
  'If he MISSES his flight' ('if he
  will miss' - XATO)
  ⚠ ASOSIY QISMDA WILL:
  'she WILL buy a car' ('she buys'
  - XATO)


⚠ 3-ShAXS -S 'IF' QISMIDA:

  misses, goes, wakes up, rains.
  Inkor: doesn't set, don't have,
  aren't.


⚠ 'WON'T BE ABLE TO':

  = ... olmaydi ('can' ning
  kelajagi).


⚠ 'TO HURT YOURSELF':

  = o'zingni shikastlab olmoq.


⚠ 'TO SET AN ALARM CLOCK':

  = budilnikni qo'ymoq.


⚠ 'TO LOSE WEIGHT':

  = ozmoq (vazn yo'qotmoq).

exercises.explanationUz:
ShART + NATIJA - MA'NOGA QARAB.

  1 bosh og'rig'i → aspirin (c)
  2 kech yotsang → ertaga
    charchaysan (f)
  3 tushlik qilmasam → keyin och
    qolaman (d)
  4 zararli ovqat yemasang →
    sog'lomroq bo'lasan (a)
  5 issiq bo'lsa → derazani ochaman
    (b)
  6 yomg'ir to'xtasa → bog'da sayr
    (e)


⚠ 'JUNK FOOD':

  = zararli tez ovqat (chips,
  burger).


⚠ 'HEALTHIER':

  = sog'lomroq (healthy → healthIER).


⚠ 'TO GET A HEADACHE':

exercises.instructionUz: Ko'rsatmalar bilan gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek. Agar siz ... nima bo'ladi? 1 Parijga borsangiz? 2 ertaga qorningiz og'risa? 3 xonangizni yig'ishtirishni unutsangiz? 4 shahar markaziga borsangiz? 5 kechki ovqatdan keyin juda charchasangiz? 6 imtihonlarni yaxshi topshirsangiz? 7 bazm qilsangiz? 8 avtobusga kech qolsangiz?
exercises.explanationUz:
1-TUR ShART - O'Z JAVOBINGIZ.

  QOLIP: If I + PRESENT, I will +
  fe'l.


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'If I go to Paris, I will visit
   the Eiffel Tower.'


⚠ 'A STOMACH ACHE':

  = qorin og'rig'i. /ˈstʌmək eɪk/.


⚠ 'TO DO WELL IN EXAMS':

  = imtihonlarni yaxshi topshirmoq.


⚠ 'TO MISS THE BUS':

  = avtobusga kech qolmoq.
exercises.exampleEn: If I go to Paris, I will visit the Eiffel Tower.
exercises.exampleUz: Agar Parijga borsam, Eyfel minorasiga boraman.
modelAnswers: If I have a stomach ache tomorrow, I will go to the doctor.
If I forget to tidy my room, my mother will be angry.
If I go to the city centre, I will do some shopping.
If I am very tired after dinner, I will go to bed early.
If I do well in my exams, my parents will buy me a present.
If I have a party, I will invite all my friends.
If I miss the bus, I will be late for school.
modelAnswersUz: Agar ertaga qornim og'risa, shifokorga boraman.
Agar xonamni yig'ishtirishni unutsam, onamning jahli chiqadi.
Agar shahar markaziga borsam, xarid qilaman.
Agar kechki ovqatdan keyin juda charchasam, erta yotaman.
Agar imtihonlarni yaxshi topshirsam, ota-onam menga sovg'a sotib oladi.
Agar bazm qilsam, barcha do'stlarimni taklif qilaman.
Agar avtobusga kech qolsam, maktabga kech qolaman.

exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi rasmlarga qarang, so'ng ko'rsatmalar bilan har bir kishi shu yozda bitirganida nima qilishi haqida gaplar tuzing. a Mark - go to Sydney b Fay - travel to New York c Gary - have a party d Kim - get a job e Sam - buy a computer f Ann - buy a car
exercises.explanationUz:
'WHEN' + PRESENT, ... WILL.

  ⚠ 'When' ham 'if' kabi: 'when'
  qismida PRESENT SIMPLE, asosiy
  qismda WILL.
  'When Mark graduateS, he'LL go'.

  ⚠ 'if' = agar (bo'lishi aniq
  emas); 'when' = qachonki (bo'lishi
  ANIQ - bitiradi).


⚠ 'TO GRADUATE':

  = bitirmoq (universitet/maktab).
  'graduation' = bitiruv.


⚠ RASMLAR:

  a Sidney - Harbour Bridge va
    Opera teatri
  b Nyu-York - Ozodlik haykali
  c 'Bring a friend' - bazm
    taklifnomasi
  d portfel - ish
  e kompyuter
  f mashina

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with will, 'm afraid, 'd like, could or would.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni will, 'm afraid, 'd like, could yoki would bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
TELEFONDA - RASMIY MULOQOT.

  I'D LIKE to speak to ... =
    ... bilan gaplashmoqchi edim
    (muloyim so'rov)
  I'M AFRAID he's in a meeting =
    afsuski, u yig'ilishda
    (yomon xabarni yumshatish)
  WOULD you like to leave a
    message? = xabar qoldirasizmi?
  COULD you tell him ...? =
    unga ayta olasizmi? (muloyim
    iltimos)
  I WILL ask him = so'rayman
    (va'da)


⚠ 'I'M AFRAID':

  = afsuski (qo'rqaman EMAS!).
  Yomon xabar oldidan.


⚠ 'TO LEAVE A MESSAGE':

  = xabar qoldirmoq.


⚠ 'AS SOON AS HE'S FINISHED':

  = u tugatishi bilan ('he has
  finished' - present perfect,
  kelajak ma'nosida).


⚠ 'TO CONTACT':

  = bog'lanmoq.


⚠ 'CERTAINLY, SIR':

  = albatta, janob (rasmiy).

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hello. I 1) ___ to speak to Mr Harris, please.
lines.uz: Salom. Janob Xarris bilan gaplashmoqchi edim, iltimos.
lines.whyUz: ⚠ Muloyim so'rov: 'I'd like to speak to ...'.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I 2) ___ he's in a meeting at the moment. 3) ___ you like to leave a message?
lines.uz: Afsuski, u hozir yig'ilishda. Xabar qoldirasizmi?
lines.whyUz:
⚠ Yomon xabar → 'I'm afraid'.
⚠ Taklif → 'Would you like ...?'

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yes, please. 4) ___ you tell him that Mr Jones called?
lines.uz: Ha, iltimos. Unga janob Jons qo'ng'iroq qilganini ayta olasizmi?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Certainly, sir. I 5) ___ ask him to contact you as soon as he's finished.
lines.uz: Albatta, janob. Tugatishi bilan siz bilan bog'lanishini so'rayman.
